description: This file contains unit tests for the `RingRangeCollection` class, verifying operations like containment, intersection, and difference calculations. It uses the Xunit testing framework and includes property-based testing with Gen and Sample methods.

classes.name: RingRangeCollectionTests
classes.description: A test class providing various unit tests for the RingRangeCollection class, including containment, intersection, and difference calculations.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Tests the containment of random points within the collection.

methods.name: Intersects
methods.description: Validates that each range in the collection correctly reports intersection with the collection itself.

methods.name: Difference
methods.description: Checks the difference operation between an original and an updated collection, asserting correct intersections.

methods.name: ContainsTest
methods.description: Performs comprehensive containment tests, including counts for points.

methods.name: ContainsWrappedTest
methods.description: Tests containment with specific wrapped ranges and boundary points.
